jobs.description:
On-call Waiters & Bartenders - Bring your personality to Hobo Copenhagen

A warm hello. A thoughtful recommendation. Noticing when someone could use a hand. Great hospitality starts with small moments, and we’re looking for people who enjoy creating them.

We’re looking for on-call waiters and bartenders to join our F&B team at Hobo Copenhagen, helping out across our cocktailbar, all-day bar & café, restaurant and breakfast service.

You might already have some hospitality experience, or you might be looking for your first opportunity in the industry. What matters most is your personality, reliability and willingness to learn. Bring your curiosity and energy, and we’ll help you build your skills.

Find your feet with us

You’ll work alongside experienced colleagues who will show you the ropes and support you during service. Depending on your experience and interests, you’ll:

• 
Welcome guests and help them feel comfortable from the moment they arrive.

• 
Serve food and drinks, learning about our menus so you can share favourites and make recommendations with confidence.

• 
Support service behind the bar, preparing drinks and keeping the bar ready for the next round.

• 
Help prepare for service, set tables and keep our spaces welcoming throughout the shift.

• 
Stay attentive to guests, listen to their requests and ask a colleague whenever you need a hand.

• 
Support the team with clearing, resetting and the everyday details that keep service flowing.

You don’t need to be equally experienced on the floor and behind the bar. Tell us what you enjoy and where you feel confident, and we’ll explore where you fit best.

What you bring

You enjoy meeting people and are happy to let your personality show. You’re curious, approachable and willing to get involved, even when something is new to you.

You take your commitments seriously, arrive ready for your shift and support your colleagues when things get busy. You’re comfortable asking questions and taking feedback as you learn.

You can communicate with guests and colleagues in English. Experience from a restaurant, café or bar is welcome, and being comfortable working both on the floor and behind the bar is a definite plus.

You should be available to work at least every other weekend. Being able and keen to work more is a welcome plus. Shifts can be in the morning, daytime or evening.

What you’ll be part of

At Hobo, we bring a professional, passionate and playful approach to hospitality. We care about good service and want people to feel comfortable being themselves, both as guests and as colleagues.

You’ll join a new team during our opening journey, with hands-on training, supportive colleagues and the chance to grow in confidence as you gain experience.

Hobo Copenhagen is part of Strawberry, alongside hotels such as Admiral Hotel and Villa Copenhagen. You’ll be part of a wider hospitality family, with staff benefits according to your employment terms.

Let’s talk

We’d love to hear a little about you, what you enjoy and why you’d like to join Hobo. Tell us whether your interests lie on the floor, behind the bar or a bit of both, along with when you’re available to work.

If you have hospitality experience, tell us about it. If you don’t, tell us what makes you keen to get started.

The practical details

• 
Position: On-call waiter or bartender, with shifts agreed according to business needs and your availability.

• 
Start date: February 2027, with the exact date to be agreed.

• 
Location: Hobo Copenhagen, Helgolandsgade 3, 1653 Copenhagen V.

• 
Working hours: Morning, daytime and evening shifts, primarily at weekends. You should be available at least every other weekend,  and we’d love to hear if you’re keen to work more.

• 
Questions: Contact Gobo Hansen, F&B Manager, at gobo.hansen@hobohotel.dk.

• 
Application deadline: November 16th

We review applications and meet candidates on an ongoing basis, and positions may be filled before the application deadline.

Chef - full time

Bring your craft to the kitchen at Hobo Copenhagen

You care about good food, enjoy a busy service and know how much a kitchen depends on the people in it. Now you’re ready to help build something new.

We’re looking for chefs to join Hobo Copenhagen in full-time positions, with a primary focus on our evening à la carte restaurant. You’ll also contribute to the food offering in our all-day bar, working as part of one kitchen team.

Our restaurant offers dishes made for sharing, good ingredients and confident flavours. We’re looking for people who bring care to their cooking, ideas to the conversation and a willingness to support the team.

Good food starts with us

Together with the Head Chef and your kitchen colleagues, you’ll help build a modern kitchen culture where everyone feels welcome and respected. We value calm, clear communication, constructive feedback and helping each other through a busy service. Everyone should feel comfortable asking questions, sharing ideas and learning.

Your role will include:

• 
Preparing and cooking dishes with attention to flavour, seasoning and presentation, keeping quality consistent throughout service.

• 
Looking after your section, planning your preparation and keeping your station organised and ready for a busy evening.

• 
Contributing ideas as we develop dishes, seasonal menus and the everyday food offering across our restaurant and all-day bar.

• 
Working closely with the service team to find the right pace, communicate clearly and take care of dietary requirements.

• 
Making thoughtful use of ingredients, keeping track of stock and helping reduce food waste.

• 
Following food safety, hygiene and allergen procedures, including checks and documentation in e-smiley.

• 
Sharing knowledge, helping colleagues and leaving the kitchen ready for the next service.

What you bring

You have professional kitchen experience, preferably from a busy à la carte restaurant, and feel comfortable running your own section.

You enjoy cooking food that people want to gather around. You’re attentive to the details, curious about ingredients and techniques, and open to both sharing ideas and learning from others.

You take responsibility for your work and contribute to a supportive atmosphere. You listen, share your knowledge and treat colleagues with respect, whatever their role or experience. When the pace picks up, you communicate clearly and work with the team to find solutions.

Relevant culinary training is welcome, and we also value strong practical experience. You can communicate confidently in English and are comfortable working evenings and weekends.

What you’ll be part of

At Hobo, we bring a professional, passionate and playful approach to hospitality. We want that to be felt in the kitchen as well as in the guest experience.

You’ll join during the opening journey, with the opportunity to contribute to menus, routines and team culture from the beginning. You’ll work closely with the Head Chef and a team that values good food, clear communication and room to develop.

Hobo Copenhagen is part of Strawberry, alongside hotels such as Admiral Hotel and Villa Copenhagen. We bring our own personality to that wider hospitality family, with access to development opportunities, staff hotel rates and food and beverage benefits.

Let’s talk

We’d love to hear about the person behind the CV. Tell us where you’ve worked, what you enjoy cooking and what matters to you in a kitchen team.

The practical details

• 
Position: Full-time chef.

• 
Start date: February 2027.

• 
Location: Hobo Copenhagen, Helgolandsgade 3, 1653 Copenhagen V.

• 
Working hours: Primarily afternoon and evening shifts, including weekends. Shifts typically start between 11:00 and 15:00 and finish between 22:00 and midnight, depending on the schedule.

• 
Questions: Contact Gobo Hansen, F&B Manager, at gobo.hansen@hobohotel.dk.

• 
Application deadline: November 16th

We review applications and meet candidates on an ongoing basis, and positions may be filled before the application deadline.

Bartender fulltime - Shape the bar at Hobo Copenhagen

You know your craft. You care about what goes into the glass, how a bar runs and how people feel when they walk through the door. You understand that a warm welcome, eye contact and genuine attention can set the tone for an entire evening. Now you’re ready to help build something new.

We’re looking for experienced bartenders to join Hobo Copenhagen in a full-time position, with a primary focus on our new cocktail bar. You’ll help develop a bar with its own identity, where cocktails, music and warm, confident hospitality come together.

Your main home will be in the cocktail bar, while you’ll also work alongside the teams in our all-day bar and restaurant & bar. We’re building one F&B team, with shared standards and a willingness to support each other.

Your craft. Your responsibility.

Working closely with the Bar & Restaurant Manager and the wider F&B team, you will:

• 
Help develop and refine our cocktail offering, contributing ideas, testing recipes and translating the concept into drinks that work consistently during service.

• 
Take ownership of your shifts, from preparation and station setup to handovers and closing, keeping the team organised and the bar ready for the next service.

• 
Work confidently with batching, dilution, temperature and presentation, understanding how preparation supports both quality and time with guests.

• 
Make every first impression count: acknowledge guests as they arrive, read the room and bring warmth and genuine attention to each interaction.

• 
Maintain control of stock, rotation, waste and product quality, and contribute to ordering and stocktaking.

• 
Share knowledge with colleagues and help strengthen beverage standards across our outlets.

What you bring

You have solid cocktail experience from one of Copenhagen’s leading bars, or a similarly ambitious bar elsewhere.

Just as importantly, you take responsibility. You notice what needs doing, follow through and support the people around you. You can deliver during a busy service while still making time to welcome guests, guide them through the menu and help them feel at home.

You enjoy working in a team, communicate confidently in English and are comfortable working evenings, nights and weekends. A particular interest in spirits, fermentation or another part of the beverage world is welcome.

What you’ll be part of

At Hobo, we bring a professional, passionate and playful approach to hospitality. We want high standards to feel natural, personal and welcoming.

You’ll join during the opening journey, with the opportunity to influence the drinks, routines and team culture from the beginning. We offer close collaboration with the F&B leadership team, room to contribute and colleagues who care about their craft.

Hobo Copenhagen is part of Strawberry, alongside hotels such as Admiral Hotel and Villa Copenhagen. We bring our own personality to that wider hospitality family, with access to development opportunities, staff hotel rates and food and beverage benefits.

Let’s talk

First impressions matter to us, and we’d love to get a sense of the person behind the CV. Tell us where you’ve worked, what you care about in a bar and how you make a guest feel welcome from the very first interaction. Bring the same warmth and personality you would bring to meeting someone across the bar.

The practical details

• 
Position: Full-time bartender.

• 
Start date: February 2027.

• 
Location: Hobo Copenhagen, Helgolandsgade 3, 1653 Copenhagen V.

• 
Working hours: Varied shifts, including evenings, nights and weekends.

• 
Questions: Contact Gobo Hansen, F&B Manager, at gobo.hansen@hobohotel.dk.

• 
Application deadline: November 16th

We review applications and meet candidates on an ongoing basis, and the position may be filled before the application deadline.

Full Time Waiter - Bring your hospitality to the table at Hobo Copenhagen

You know how to make a service flow. You notice the details, read your guests and understand that a warm welcome can set the tone for an entire visit. Now you’re ready to help build something new.

We’re looking for experienced waiters to join Hobo Copenhagen in full-time positions within our all-day bar & café, evening à la carte restaurant and breakfast team.

Whether you feel most at home in a lively dinner service or enjoy the variety of different settings, we’d love to hear from you. Your experience, personality and interests will help shape where you fit best within our F&B team.

Good service starts with us

Together with the Bar & Restaurant Manager and your F&B colleagues, you’ll help create welcoming spaces and enjoyable experiences throughout the day. Your role will include:

• 
Looking after your section with care, making guests feel welcome and keeping service flowing from their first hello to their last goodbye.

• 
Bringing the menu to life with your own favourites and thoughtful recommendations, sharing your enthusiasm while staying curious about what each guest enjoys.

• 
Bringing your own style of hospitality to your service, adapting to the atmosphere and the people around you.

• 
Staying connected with the kitchen and bar, communicating guest preferences and dietary requirements clearly and finding the right pace together.

• 
Getting ready for service as a team, keeping your station organised and leaving colleagues well prepared for the next shift.

• 
Listening to guests and handling feedback with warmth, with your colleagues and manager there to support you.

• 
Sharing ideas and experience as we develop our service style, daily routines and team culture ahead of opening.

What you bring

You have solid à la carte waiting experience, ideally at least two years, and feel confident managing your own section in a busy restaurant.

You care about people as much as the practical side of service. You notice when a guest needs guidance, when a table needs space and when a colleague could use a hand. You take responsibility, follow through and keep your attention on the room when the pace picks up.

You bring a positive, collaborative approach and enjoy supporting the people around you. Let us know which service setting you enjoy most, whether that’s evening à la carte, daytime hospitality or a mix.

You communicate confidently in English. Knowledge of wine, cocktails or speciality coffee is a welcome bonus, along with the curiosity to keep learning and share what you know.

What you’ll be part of

At Hobo, we bring a professional, passionate and playful approach to hospitality. We want high standards to feel natural, personal and welcoming.

You’ll join during the opening journey, with the opportunity to influence our service, routines and team culture from the beginning. We offer close collaboration with the F&B leadership team, room to contribute and colleagues who care about their craft.

Hobo Copenhagen is part of Strawberry, alongside hotels such as Admiral Hotel and Villa Copenhagen. We bring our own personality to that wider hospitality family, with access to development opportunities, staff hotel rates and food and beverage benefits.

Let’s talk

First impressions matter to us, and we’d love to get a sense of the person behind the CV. Tell us where you’ve worked, what good hospitality means to you and how you make a guest feel welcome from the very first interaction. Bring the same warmth and personality you would bring to a table.

The practical details

• 
Position: Full-time waiter.

• 
Start date: February 2027.

• 
Location: Hobo Copenhagen, Helgolandsgade 3, 1653 Copenhagen V.

• 
Working hours: Shifts depend on your role and agreed schedule, including weekends. Both primarily evening roles and a mix of morning, daytime and evening shifts are possible.

• 
Questions: Contact Gobo Hansen, F&B Manager, at gobo.hansen@hobohotel.dk.

• 
Application deadline: November 16th

We review applications and meet candidates on an ongoing basis, and positions may be filled before the application deadline.

Chef - part time

Bring your craft to the kitchen at Hobo Copenhagen

Good food, good teamwork and the feeling of a service coming together. If you enjoy being part of a kitchen and want to keep learning, we’d love to meet you.

We’re looking for part-time chefs to join Hobo Copenhagen, supporting our evening à la carte restaurant and all-day bar. Our food centres on dishes made for sharing, good ingredients and confident flavours.

You might already work in a kitchen, be training as a chef or have some practical experience you’d like to build on. What matters to us is that you bring care to your work, curiosity and a willingness to get involved.

Good food starts with us

You’ll work alongside the Head Chef and your kitchen colleagues in a modern, inclusive kitchen. We value calm, clear communication, constructive feedback and helping each other through a busy service. There’s room to ask questions, share ideas and learn.

Depending on your experience, you’ll:

• 
Help prepare ingredients and cook dishes for our restaurant and all-day bar.

• 
Support service with attention to flavour, presentation and consistency.

• 
Keep your station organised and help the team get ready for service.

• 
Handle ingredients with care and contribute to reducing food waste.

• 
Follow our food safety, hygiene and allergen procedures, with guidance from the team.

• 
Help with cleaning, closing and leaving the kitchen ready for your colleagues.

We’ll introduce you to our dishes and routines, building your responsibilities around your skills and experience.

What you bring

You have some practical kitchen experience and enjoy cooking. Experience from an à la carte restaurant is welcome, but you don’t need years of experience or formal culinary training to get in touch.

You’re reliable, curious and happy to lend a hand. You arrive ready for your shift, take feedback positively and ask when you’re unsure.

You treat colleagues with respect and help create a supportive atmosphere. When service gets busy, you stay attentive, communicate clearly and work with the people around you.

You can communicate with your colleagues in English.

You’ll work at least every other weekend as part of your agreed schedule. Being able and keen to work more is a welcome plus.

What you’ll be part of

At Hobo, we bring a professional, passionate and playful approach to hospitality. We care about good food and want people to feel comfortable being themselves.

You’ll join a new team during our opening journey, with practical training, supportive colleagues and the opportunity to develop your skills.

Hobo Copenhagen is part of Strawberry, alongside hotels such as Admiral Hotel and Villa Copenhagen. You’ll be part of a wider hospitality family, with staff benefits according to your employment terms.

Let’s talk

We’d love to hear a little about you, your kitchen experience and what you enjoy cooking. Tell us what you’d like to learn, what you bring to a team and how many hours you’re looking to work.

The practical details

• 
Position: Part-time chef, with contracted hours agreed during the recruitment process.

• 
Start date: February 2027.

• 
Location: Hobo Copenhagen, Helgolandsgade 3, 1653 Copenhagen V.

• 
Working hours: Primarily afternoon and evening shifts, including at least every other weekend. Shifts typically fall between 11:00 and midnight, depending on the schedule. Being able and keen to work more is a welcome plus.

• 
Questions: Contact Gobo Hansen, F&B Manager, at gobo.hansen@hobohotel.dk.

• 
Application deadline: November 16th

We review applications and meet candidates on an ongoing basis, and positions may be filled before the application deadline.

_Please do not contact us or apply if you are a recruiter, consultant or outsourcing company.

_**Deliver with focus. Scale with intent 🚀

**Are you a delivery leader who knows how to guide enterprise customers through complex set-ups without over-engineering the journey? Do you care deeply about building scalable, repeatable SaaS delivery rather than one-off custom projects?

At Performativ, we’re building the infrastructure layer for modern wealth management. As our Engagement Manager, you’ll lead the enterprise rollout of our SaaS platform helping customers onboard successfully through structured delivery, clear communication, and lightweight technical engagement.

This is not a professional services consulting role. You won’t be buried in endless customer-specific code or heavy customizations. Instead, you’ll work cross-functionally to help customers adopt our product the right way: cleanly, securely, and in line with platform best practices so they can scale on top of us, not around us.

**What You Will Do

**

• 
Own enterprise set-up programs end to end (kick-off through go-live and hyper-care) against an agreed plan and scope (Statement of Work).

• 
Enable customers to integrate Performativ via standard platform patterns (APIs, SSO, configuration) without custom buildouts, working with product and engineering to flag gaps early and advocate for scalable paths.

• 
Own plan, scope, and change control, keeping scope tied to contract and change visible and decided rather than quietly absorbed, and support the Technical Program Lead on requirements, design documents, and acceptance-criteria sign-off.

• 
Run customer communication, cadence, and governance with reporting that keeps meetings short, and manage risk, dependency, and issue tracking (including customer-side).

• 
Lead a clean handover to Customer Success at go-live or hyper-care exit, including train-the-trainer sessions and supporting materials.

• 
Represent the program in internal capacity and exception reviews, bringing requests the plan cannot absorb back as options rather than committing on the spot.

• 
Build repeatable playbooks, documentation, and artefacts that make the next program faster. You will be measured on this, not only on your own delivery.

**How You Will Work

**You will run multiple programs at once, in a delivery pod alongside the Technical Program Lead, Integration Engineers, Data Migration Specialists, and Product Engineers. None report to you. Rather you get things done through clarity and relationships, not authority. You will report to the COO. This is an in-office role based at our Copenhagen office.

**What We're Looking For

**

• 
7+ years in program or engagement management, consulting, product management, or another delivery-facing role, with a track record of leading complex, multi-stakeholder implementations end to end.

• 
Comfort being firm with customers on scope and timeline while keeping the relationship stronger for it.

• 
Any industry background welcome. Experience with enterprise customers (banks, asset managers, regulated industries), balancing urgency against long-term maintainability highly advantageous.

• 
Structured and highly organized, producing written plans, governance cadences, and reporting that stakeholders can act on.

• 
Broad technical literacy across enterprise SaaS delivery: API-based integrations, SSO and security configuration, and data migration and mapping, including enough SQL to read and question a mapping. You do not build the integration, but you understand it well enough to scope it, question it, and know when something does not add up.

• 
Ability to build working fluency in the customer's business domain fast: within 90 days, able to discuss topics such as advice and suitability workflows and customer reporting without a subject-matter expert in the room.

• 
ITIL Foundation, PMP or PRINCE2 Certification would be beneficial.

**Technical Fluency

**

• 
You’re not, necessarily, a developer, but you’re comfortable with APIs, data structures, auth flows (OAuth/SAML), and deployment models.

• 
You can dive into logs, payloads, and basic SQL or Python when needed to unblock yourself or a customer - but you prioritize scalable fixes over tactical workarounds.

• 
You advocate for platform-aligned solutions, not special cases.

**What This Role Is Not

**This role sits in operations, not engineering or commercial, and is project-based: once delivery is complete, you roll on to the next engagement. As a SaaS provider, we do not build bespoke software; delivery works within the bounds of the product.

**We Can Offer

**

• 
Trust and responsibility to shape how Performativ delivers for its largest customers.

• 
A competitive salary and benefits package.

• 
A fast-growing, VC-backed fintech scaleup, working alongside professionals from leading institutions (Goldman Sachs, McKinsey, BCG, Amazon and others).

• 
Career acceleration through professional development and leadership opportunities.

jobs.occupation: Intern auditor til informationssikkerhed i Region Midtjylland - tidsbegrænset stilling
jobs.description:
Vil du være med til at styrke informationssikkerheden i en af Danmarks største offentlige organisationer?

I Region Midtjylland søger vi en intern auditor, der skal bidrage til at evaluere og videreudvikle regionens ledelsessystem for informationssikkerhed. Du får en central rolle i arbejdet med at sikre, at krav til informationssikkerhed efterleves, og at regionens politikker, procedurer og sikkerhedsforanstaltninger fungerer efter hensigten.

Som intern auditor skal du planlægge og gennemføre interne audits på tværs af organisationen og medvirke til at skabe overblik over styrker, risici og forbedringsmuligheder, som understøtter ledelsens beslutningsgrundlag. Du bliver samtidig en vigtig sparringspartner, der understøtter en kultur, hvor audit opleves som et redskab til læring, udvikling og løbende forbedring af informationssikkerheden.

 

Dine primære opgaver

Du får ansvar for at etablere og videreudvikle regionens proces for intern audit samt udarbejde og vedligeholde et risikobaseret auditprogram.

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være at:

• Udarbejde regionens auditprogram
• Planlægge og gennemføre interne audits i overensstemmelse med auditprogrammet og gældende krav til informationssikkerhed
• Fastlægge auditmål, auditkriterier og auditomfang
• Indsamle og vurdere dokumentation, interviewoplysninger, observationer og øvrige revisionsbeviser
• Vurdere efterlevelsen af ISO 27001 samt regionens politikker, retningslinjer og procedurer
• Identificere afvigelser, risici, forbedringsmuligheder og eksempler på god praksis
• Udarbejde rapporter og præsentere auditresultater for ledelse og relevante interessenter
• Bidrage til opfølgning på identificerede forbedringsområder
• Sikre, at eksisterende audits, tilsyn, it-revisioner og øvrige kontrolaktiviteter inddrages aktivt, så allerede tilgængelig viden udnyttes bedst muligt
 

Om dig

Vi søger en intern auditor, der er tillidsvækkende i dialogen med andre og formår at skabe gode og konstruktive samarbejdsrelationer på tværs af organisationen. Du møder medarbejdere og ledere med en anerkendende og respektfuld tilgang og udviser tålmodighed i auditprocessen. Samtidig har du modet til at identificere og påpege fejl, mangler og forbedringsmuligheder på en saglig og konstruktiv måde. Du ser intern audit som et redskab til læring og kvalitetsudvikling frem for kontrol.

Vi forestiller os derudover, at du:

• Er analytisk stærk og kan omsætte komplekse problemstillinger til klare konklusioner
• Har gode skriftlige og mundtlige formidlingsevner
• Arbejder struktureret og selvstændigt
• Evner at skabe samarbejde og tillid på tværs af forskellige fagområder
• Har kendskab til informationssikkerhed og ISO27001
 

Hvem er vi?

Du bliver ansat i informationssikkerhedsteamet i Digital Forvaltning, som er en del af Region Midtjyllands samlede informationssikkerhedsfunktion. Funktionen er et samarbejde mellem Sikkerhed og Compliance, som er en del af Digitalisering og It samt Juridisk Kontor og Digital Forvaltning, som er en del af Regionssekretariatet. 

Digital Forvaltning arbejder for at fremme digitalisering og sikre en systematisk, fælles ramme for informationssikkerhedsarbejdet i hele regionen. Vi er en del af Regionssekretariatet, der også varetager sekretariatsbetjening af regionsråd og direktion samt en række tværgående opgaver.

Arbejdssted: Regionshuset Viborg, Skottenborg 26, 8800 Viborg

 

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår 

Stillingen er tidsbegrænset frem til den 31. december 2028 med evt. mulighed for forlængelse.

Stillingen er som udgangspunkt en fuldtidsstilling.

Ansøgningsfrist den 5. december 2026. 

Ansættelsessamtaler forventes afholdt den 15. december 2026.  

Tiltrædelse: 1. februar 2027 eller efter aftale. 

Løn– og ansættelsesforhold i henhold til gældende overenskomst. 

 

Yderligere information om stillingen

Hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen, kan du kontakte Rikke Stein, Kontorchef i Digital Forvaltning, på telefonnummer 21359030 eller på mail rikke.stein@rm.dk.

 

Stillingen er som udgangspunkt en fuldtidsstilling.

Da Region Midtjylland løbende gennemfører besparelser og omorganiseringer, vil medarbejdere i omplacering, der søger stillingen, have fortrinsret.

Region Midtjylland er jf. EU’s løngennemsigtighedsdirektiv, der trådte i kraft 7. juni 2026 forpligtet til at oplyse dig om startløn eller et interval for startløn for en stilling inden du tilbydes ansættelse.

Her finder du Region Midtjyllands lønkatalog for de fleste faggrupper og stillinger, som findes i Region Midtjylland: Gennemsigtighed forud for ansættelse - Medarbejder.rm.dk

Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.

We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!

**Job Description

**As the Business Operations Program Manager you will be important member of the Global IPP Operations team and drive business productivity, process optimization, and organizational change projects across the IPP business. You will focus on improving end-to-end operational performance by implementing sustainable business improvements that enhance efficiency, collaboration, scalability, and customer responsiveness.

Acting as a strategic partner, you will support Project Management, Application Engineering, Manufacturing, and Business Operations teams. You will lead cross-functional initiatives that achieve four key objectives: simplifying processes, improving operational effectiveness, accelerating execution, and enabling business growth.

You will work closely with the Manufacturing teams in Katowice and CUBIC, ensuring strong alignment between operational improvement initiatives, production capabilities, and business objectives across the global IPP organization. You will combine data-driven decision-making, change management expertise, and continuous improvement methodologies to deliver measurable business outcomes and ensure successful adoption of transformational projects.

You will report to the Global IPP Business Operations Manager. This position is hybrid and located in EMEA, preferably near a Rockwell Automation IPP facility.

**Your Responsibilities

**

• 
Business Productivity and Process Improvement

• 
Lead business productivity projects across the IPP organization focused on improving efficiency and enhancing operational performance.

• 
Identify process bottlenecks and improvement opportunities across Project Management, Application Engineering, Manufacturing, and Business Operations.

• 
Develop and implement standardized processes, best practices, and governance mechanisms across the IPP business.

• 
Promote a culture of continuous improvement and operational excellence across the organization.

• 
Change Management and Business Transformation

• 
Lead change management activities associated with strategic business initiatives, organizational transformations, system implementations, and process improvements.

• 
Partner with functional leaders to reinforce desired behaviors and ensure long-term adoption of new processes and tools.

• 
Establish change management methodologies, frameworks, and best practices within the IPP organization.

• 
Cross-Functional Business Integration

• 
Act as a liaison between Project Management, Application Engineering, Manufacturing, Business Operations, Commercial teams, and IPP Leadership.

• 
Drive alignment of priorities, processes, and performance goals across departments and regions.

• 
Support implementation of integrated business processes that enhance visibility and accountability

• 
Facilitate stakeholder alignment and resolution of process-related challenges impacting business performance.

• 
Performance Analytics and Operational Effectiveness

• 
Analyze operational trends to identify improvement opportunities and support data-driven decision-making.

• 
Monitor key metrics including productivity, lead time, OTTR, process adoption, and operational performance.

• 
Measure and communicate the impact of productivity and transformation programs.

• 
Support data governance efforts to improve visibility and reporting accuracy.

• 
Strategic Program Management

• 
Lead and coordinate productivity and transformation projects aligned with IPP strategic goals.

• 
Develop project charters, business cases, implementation roadmaps, and success metrics.

• 
Identify project risks, dependencies, and mitigation actions.

• 
Provide regular updates and recommendations to the IPP Leadership Team.

• 
Continuous Improvement

• 
Lead or support continuous improvement projects focused on operational productivity, process simplification, organizational effectiveness, and business performance.

•

Student Assistant for Software Development at Novo Nordisk Engineering

If you're energised by software development and thrive on solving real business challenges through technology, we'd love to hear from you!

Who we are

We are a leading pharma engineering company shaping the future of API pharma engineering globally. Leveraging the expertise of 2,000+ employees across Denmark, India, and the US, we design, build and optimise pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities that are essential to the health and well-being of patients everywhere.

Our success is driven by passion, innovation, and collaboration — with our customers and across our teams and disciplines. If you share our dedication to a noble cause and our passion for API pharma engineering, then NNE is the place for you.

About the role

We are looking for a student software developer to join our system development team in Global IT.

As a team, we support NNE's engineering project portfolios and build modern applications that help colleagues work smarter across projects and locations.

As a student software developer, you will play an important role in supporting the team's development efforts by contributing to real business-critical solutions, helping maintain high quality through testing, and bringing fresh perspectives on emerging technologies such as Azure and AI.

This is a part-time position of around 2–3 days a week. You will work on real tasks from day one, with a dedicated colleague to guide you, review your code and help you grow.

How you might spend your days

As a student software developer, you’ll be:

• Developing new features and fixing bugs in our applications, APIs and services

• Building front-end components and backend endpoints under guidance from experienced developers

• Helping perform testing of our applications, running test cases, reporting defects and writing automated tests to keep our quality high

• Taking part in our agile ways of working, stand-ups, sprint planning and code reviews

• Exploring new tools and technologies, such as cloud services on Microsoft Azure and AI and sharing what you learn with the team

Who you are

We care about who you are as a person. In the end, how you work, and your energy is what impacts the results we achieve as a team. As a person, you are:

• A self-learner who picks up new technologies and tools on your own initiative and is not afraid to ask questions when you get stuck

• Structured and responsible, taking ownership of your tasks and delivering what you commit to

• Collaborative and comfortable working with colleagues across disciplines, locations and cultures

• Curious and proactive in suggesting improvements to tools, processes and technical solutions

• Open to feedback and ready to learn from mistakes, with high spirits and a sense of humour

What you bring to the role

In all positions, there are some things that are preferred, and others, a bonus. If you do not meet all the qualifications listed below, you are welcome to offer alternative experience that you think would be valuable in this role:

• Are studying for a bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, software engineering or a related field

• Have a basic understanding of programming in C#/.NET or Python

• Have some experience with HTML, CSS and JavaScript, and ideally a modern framework such as React

• Know the basics of relational databases and SQL

• Have used Git for version control

• Communicate well in English, written and spoken

It’s a bonus if you have tried automated testing, CI/CD or cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure.

Life at NNE

NNE is short for Novo Nordisk Engineering. And for all of us who work here, NNE means so much more.

At NNE, you become part of a vibrant, project-based environment built on close day-to-day collaboration. The role is therefore primarily on-site, with physical presence at the workplace expected five days a week. We are, at our core, a people business and, as such, committed to continuously developing our people and the way we work together. We therefore welcome new colleagues with our award-nominated onboarding programme, supported by a range of in-house talent and development initiatives designed to support your long-term growth.

Maybe you’re the kind of person who loves it when everything comes together: a candidate feels well taken care of, a new colleague has everything ready for their first day, payroll is spot on, and the details in our HR systems are exactly where they should be. If that sounds satisfying to you, you might be our new People Operations Specialist.

This is a broad, hands-on HR role where you’ll work across payroll, recruitment, onboarding, and HR administration. You’ll have plenty of opportunity to take ownership, improve the way we work, and make your mark as the role develops. You’ll be part of the HR team at Evosep, reporting directly to the HR Manager, and the role is based at our HQ in Odense.

If this sounds like you, we’d love to hear from you.

Key Tasks and Responsibilities

HR Administration & Payroll

• Manage the monthly payroll process for our Danish employees in Zenegy in close collaboration with the HR Manager, including the administration of vacation, parental leave, and other employee-related changes.

• Support the administration and maintenance of our HRMS, HR-ON Staff, ensuring employee records, organizational data, salary band information, and HR metrics are accurate and up to date.

• Prepare and provide HR data and reporting to support business needs and decision-making.

• Support the HR Manager with employment documentation, including contracts, addenda, and amendments.

• Support a wide range of day-to-day HR administrative activities.

Recruitment & Talent Acquisition

• Coordinate the recruitment process through HR-ON Recruit, including job postings, candidate communication, interview coordination, and recruitment administration.

• Track and report on recruitment metrics and KPIs, using insights to continuously improve our recruitment processes and candidate experience.

Preboarding & Onboarding

• Coordinate the employee journey from signed contract through onboarding, including IT equipment, employee accounts, system access, and coordination with relevant stakeholders.

• Ensure mandatory training is completed and correctly documented in our QMS.

• Gather feedback and track relevant metrics to continuously improve the onboarding experience.

Policies & Process Improvement

• Support the development and maintenance of HR policies, guidelines, and documentation.

• Identify opportunities to continuously improve our HR processes, systems, and overall employee experience.

Qualifications

Your most important qualification is your personality! We care about hiring people who we believe can thrive and develop at Evosep. Our team is diverse, but a positive can-do attitude and the desire to be part of something bigger than yourself are common characteristics for the entire team. For this particular role, we also imagine that you bring:

• Hands-on experience with payroll and day-to-day HR operations.

• A relevant degree in HR, Business Administration, or a related field. A bookkeeping or administrative background combined with practical HR experience is equally relevant.

• A genuine interest in supporting employees throughout their journey at Evosep.

• Strong communication skills. particularly in writing, and professional fluency in English

• Confidence working with digital tools and learning new systems. Payroll experience is essential, while Zenegy and HRIS/HRMS experience are a plus.

• Curiosity about AI and how it can make operational HR smarter and more efficient.

• Good Microsoft Office skills.

• A solid understanding of Danish employment legislation.

• A high level of discretion when working with confidential and sensitive information.

• A structured and detail-oriented way of working, even when several things are happening at once.

• A proactive approach and the confidence to take ownership and improve the way we work.

• Excitement about joining a fast-growing life sciences company and helping shape a new role.

You don’t need to tick every box to apply. If this sounds like a role where you could thrive and contribute, we encourage you to apply and tell us what you would bring to the team.

Do you want to use your understanding of electronic systems design to create innovative products that make a difference to people with hearing disabilities?

At GN Hearing, your work will support hearing solutions that help people engage more easily in the conversations and surroundings important to them.

As an Electronic Design Engineer, you will work across the development journey: shaping system specifications, exploring new technology, building and verifying prototypes, and preparing solutions for production. You will bring your experience and curiosity to a team that works closely across disciplines to solve complex technical challenges.

Your contribution will ensure our technology forms a perfect synthesis and creates a good sound when packed into our tiny hearing aids. This process takes you through system design development, prototyping and advanced platform integration technologies.

Whether you bring established PCB design experience or are ready to build further on a solid foundation, you will have knowledgeable colleagues around you and opportunities to contribute your perspective.

Welcome to GN Hearing

You will join the Electronic Integration team, part of Product Development in R&D. Our team consists of specialist engineers who collaborate across hardware, platform and product development. We value open technical discussions, practical problem-solving and sharing what we know. You will join colleagues who take their work seriously while maintaining an informal and supportive way of working.

Together with other teams, we define, design, implement and verify the ReSound programmable DSP platform, including 2.4 GHz Bluetooth Low Energy and Auracast™ wireless communication capabilities.

Your contribution is appreciated, and you will:

• Contribute to electronic design development of hearing aids and accessories, from prototype stage and design verification through to production, influencing architecture and design decisions

• Evaluate and implement new technologies in hearing-aid electronics

• Design and coordinate test verification activities to ensure reliable product performance

• Create and maintain documentation required for regulatory compliance

• Collaborate with cross-functional colleagues to integrate platform technologies into compact hearing solutions

To perform well in the role, we imagine that you:

• Hold a bachelor’s or master’s degree in electronic engineering, with a focus on signal integration or a related field

• Bring relevant experience in analog and baseband digital design

• Understand electronic systems design

• Can work through and enjoy complex technical questions and analytical problem solving

• May have experience with Cadence Allegro schematic tools

• Work well with others across technical disciplines

• Communicate proficiently in English

Job Description

Job Description

Turner & Townsend is looking for a Commissioning Manager to work on a large, complex, Data Center project in Denmark.

As Commissioning Manager, you will be responsible for managing the project Commissioning process on behalf of the Turner & Townsend Project management & Consultancy team (PM-C) on site.

This role additionally includes travel within the EU for off site factory testing & witnessing.

You’ll work closely with other business functions across projects to ensure adherence to regulatory compliance and budget requirements.

This role will require a daily, on-site presence in Denmark.

Responsibilities will include but are not limited to:

• Lead Daily/ Weekly commissioning meetings, Internally, vendor and Client

• Manage, deliver and obtain approval on relevant project commissioning documents such as Test Scripts, Compliance statements etc

• Manage the receipt, review and compliance of project commissioning documentation to achieve the necessary sign off

• Managing the Commissioning Schedule

• Manage a team of Commissioning Engineers and Vendors

• Equipment Installation Oversight

• Supervise the installation of new equipment, systems, and facilities.

• Inspect and verify the correct functioning of electrical, mechanical, and environmental control systems.

• Testing and Verification: Conduct tests to ensure operational efficacy

• Prepare and deliver Commissioning reports, progress, issues log and Risks.

• Manage the close out of commissioning risks & issues with the Contractors & Vendors.

• Verify the integrity and performance of critical systems.

• Approve the finalization of the project based on successful testing.

Qualifications

• 10 years’ experience of industrial equipment and systems commissioning & Management

• Proficiency in mechanical and electrical equipment and systems,

• Familiarity with control systems for critical infrastructures.

• Experienced in Quality Control & verification.

• Familiarity with Google drive, email etc

• Must have a “team attitude”, be self-motivated and be willing to support other groups and projects when required.

• Influencing skills as well as strong communication skills allowing you to effectively interact with clients, contractors, management, and colleagues.

• An ability to manage expectations, influence change, and report/update accurately on progress drawing on you strong planning and organization skills.

Additional Information

What We Offer:

• Exciting work in an international environment.

• Independent work with challenging tasks.

• International development perspectives and training opportunities.

• Additional benefits such as fitness initiatives, discounted event and cultural highlights, as well as shopping opportunities.

• Employer-funded pension plan.

• Modern workplace in centrally located offices with good transport connections.
